title: Houston Man Charged For Terroristic Threat Over Anime
content: A man from Houston, Texas has been charged with a third-degree felony count of terroristic threat against a public servant after allegedly leaving a profanity-ridden voicemail to the Governor's Office related to anime.
author: ANN

title: 'Kinsou no Vermeil' Manga Artist Youko Umezu Dies
content: Manga artist Youko Umezu , best known as the illustrator for Kouta Amana 's Kinsou no Vermeil ( Vermeil in Gold ) manga, died on July 7 due to a cerebral infarction. A funeral service was held by her close relatives.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Live-Action High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku Film Reveals More Cast
content: The official website for the live-action film of Ryō Nakama 's High School Family: Kokosei Kazoku ( Kōkōsei Kazoku ) manga announced seven more cast members for the film on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Altair: A Record of Battles' Kotono Katō Launches New Manga
content: Manga creator Kotono Katō launched a new manga titled Set Match! in Kodansha 's Comic Days app on August 7. The manga debuted with two chapters. The manga centers on Haruha, a timid girl who is is careless with punctuality.
author: ANN

title: 3 Things to Know Before Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4
content: Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Jujutsu Kaisen manga! Written and illustrated by Gege Akutami, the Jujutsu Kaisen manga reached its conclusion in September 2024, but the anime is far from over.

title: Persona 4 Revival Game Introduces New Features in Trailer
content: Atlus revealed a new trailer on Tuesday for Persona 4 Revival , a remake of its original 2008 role-playing game, introducing five new features for the upcoming game. title: Every Teacher Who Trained Luffy in One Piece
content: One Piece has undoubtedly emerged as the perfect shonen series, crafting many of the elements that have become staples of the genre. However, the series still stays away from classic molds, one of which is the mentor-student dynamic.
author: ComicBook

title: Uncle's Obsession with Cute Things Manga Listed to End in 13th Volume
content: Retailers are listing the 13th compiled book volume of Tsutomu's Ojisan wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki. (Older Men Like Cute Things) manga as the final volume. The volume ships on October 15. The manga centers on Mitsutaka Oji, a 40-year-old man who by all appearances is attractive and cool and is excellent at his job.
author: ANN

title: Critically Acclaimed Shonen Jump Creator Breaks Silence on Frequent Hiatuses
content: Among the many acclaimed Shonen Jump action manga, World Trigger is one such series that blends a unique sci-fi setting with tactical power play rather than overhyped battle scenes. Written and illustrated by Daisuke Ashihara, the beloved series began serialization in Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2013.
author: ComicBook

title: Flung into a New World? Time to Lift the 200-Year Curse! Light Novels Listed to End With 13th Volume
content: Retailers are listing the 13th volume of Honobonoru500 's Flung into a New World? Time to Lift the 200-Year Curse! ( Isekai ni Otosareta... Jōka wa Kihon! ) light novel series as the final volume. The novel ships on October 15.
author: ANN
